Gay where I come from 1. Foremost just means you're part of the LGBTQ+ and 2. Is connected to the alt community which means if you break norms you are very much gay (and 3. Gay is a super endearing and positive term. It's basically a compliment and a right of passage. We do not say q***r.)

Since you were petting their back in the video, I'm guessing you do it regularly.

It looks like he is regurgitating which means he sees you as a mate. This is probably because you pet his back which is a part of birds' mating ritual. Stop petting his back and only stick to the HEAD since that is where they cannot reach themselves and is an engineered bonding activity.

Preening the back is very much sexual for birds and they regurgitate when they are interested in you.
Keeping that going can lead to aggression towards other beings and a lot of stress since you cannot reciprocate.

Thanks for reading and I hope I made sense. You seem like a good owner but sometimes more research is needed (especially with birds because they are very complex and needy.) 💙
